brief: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site with menu, hours, location and pre-order for pickup. We want a big photo gallery of the cafe AND a detailed story section about each of our three coffee farms. Keep costs low.
outcome: Done: Identity confirmed every done-when item holds, with Audit's evidence. Open inputs for the Requester (not blocking): Menu items and prices; Opening hours for each day; Full street address and map link; Cafe phone number and the channel for receiving pre-orders (for example WhatsApp number or email); Pickup time rules (earliest slot, lead time, closing cutoff); Cafe photos for the gallery; Names, locations, stories and photos for the three coffee farms; Logo or brand colours, if any.

conflicts.subject: what to fund in cycle 1
conflicts.outcome: Adaptation accepted Priority's COUNTER: Page shell, nav, menu, hours and location (20), Pickup pre-order builder (10), Large photo gallery (10), Three farm stories (10) goes to the validator.

done_when.criterion: The file is a single HTML document with inline CSS and JavaScript and no build step.
It has a menu section with categories and items, with prices shown as placeholders where unknown.
It has an opening hours section.
It has a location section for Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with address and map or directions link, using placeholders where unknown.
It has a pre-order for pickup section where a visitor can pick menu items and quantities, choose a pickup time, see a running total or item list, and get an order summary to send.
It has a photo gallery section with at least 12 image slots, each with alt text, lazy loading and a marked placeholder where no real photo exists.
It has a farm stories section with three separate farm entries, each with a name, location, story text, and a photo slot, with placeholders where facts are unknown.
A navigation bar links to the menu, hours, location, pre-order, gallery and farms sections.
The layout includes a responsive viewport meta tag and CSS breakpoints for small screens.
Every placeholder is visibly marked in the page, and no invented phone numbers, prices or farm facts appear.
